episodes.title: Sam Altman: RSI, AI Consciousness, OpenAI's New Hardware, Compute, and more!
episodes.description: Altman talks through RSI, AI consciousness, OpenAI's new hardware, and the compute buildout.

episodes.title: Sam Altman, Co-Founder and CEO of OpenAI: Staying Human While Scaling Superintelligence
episodes.description: Altman reflects on scaling superintelligence while staying human, covering safety, cybersecurity risks, and his advice to founders to build the new thing.

episodes.title: Dario & Daniela Amodei: The Rise of Superintelligent AI, the End of Human Control & Humanity's Fate
episodes.description: Dario and Daniela Amodei discuss superintelligent AI, the end of human control, and what that means for humanity's fate.

episodes.title: Yann LeCun, AI legend, Co-Founder of AMI Labs, NYU Professor [AI Founders Masterclass Session 5]
episodes.description: LeCun talks with Radical Ventures' Rob Toews about world models, AMI Labs, and what comes after large language models.

episodes.title: Yann LeCun, AMI Labs | Evident AI Symposium 2026
episodes.description: LeCun explains why large language models remain limited at reasoning and planning in the physical world and why world models are the next paradigm.

episodes.title: Sam Altman's case for making compute cheap
episodes.description: Altman discusses cheap compute, agent swarms, sandboxing superhuman models, and how businesses must adapt as personal agents replace web forms and apps.
